question: Does n_rotations (and PA) correlate with ρ-min, and how do the multi-solution attractors structurally cluster?
hypothesis: Low rotational coverage under-determines (q0, ω), so ρ-min worsens with fewer rotations; multi-solution attractors form distinct structural classes.
narrative_md: Cheap cached-data analysis (~25 s, no new renders). n_rotations vs ρ-min: Spearman -0.648 (n=10), persisting -0.517 after dropping seed 10 — consistent with low-rotation under-determination. The n_rotations<2 cohort tail has 10 seeds (3,10,13,16,31,42,43,72,78,79). 19 ρ<4 multi-solution candidates cluster into 9 distinct attractors across 5 seeds (1 class_1, 4 class_2 q0 30-150° + near-truth ω, 5 class_3 near-180° flips that are NOT pure body-twins). PA shows a weaker secondary correlation (-0.540).
